agent_explanation: Shrunk case is single high-speed body (vx~37, speed~38-41) with large dt~0.0312 near the 1/30 limit, gravity 9.81, no walls/controller. Semi-implicit Euler with substeps (~41-43/substep) still accumulates positive energy drift each step: E rises from E0 6860.79 to 6998, 7159, 7344, and 7551.94 at step 4, exceeding allowed 1.1*E0+5=7551.87 by ~0.07J. Halving dt removes the drift, showing the violation is numerical energy gain due to coarse integration, not physical work.
